heading: How I Can Help
intro: I want more people to have access to good mental health support, starting with the individuals and organisations I work with. In therapy, we'll work out practical steps you can keep up.

cards.title: Workplace Wellbeing
cards.description: Confidential therapy and wellbeing consultancy for organisations, on site or remotely. This can include employee assistance, stress management programmes and resilience work with leaders. The aim is to cut absence linked to mental health and support people back to work gradually.

cards.title: Group Sessions
cards.description: Structured group therapy, where people with similar experiences support each other and I guide the sessions. I run groups for anxiety, grief and personal development throughout the year.

cards.title: Remote Sessions
cards.description: Therapy by private video or phone call, so you can fit sessions around work and home. Everything I offer is available remotely, with the same quality of care.
